svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION

g.text: Its smoke detectors, in lieu of all
PROVIDED THAT THE FIRE WARNING SYSTEM
is capable of sounding audible signals as stated in Articles 9.10.19.2. and 9.10.19.5.,
is powered as stated in Article 9.10.19.4., and
is equipped with a silencing device as stated in Article 9.10.19.6.
Not available where a fire alarm system is installed or required in the building.
CAN/ULC-S540, "Standard for Residential Fire and Life Safety Warning Systems: Installation, Inspection, Testing and Maintenance."

svg.text: Smoke detectors forming part of a residential
fire warning system installed to CAN/ULC-S540
are permitted in lieu of all smoke alarms
